title: 250 KS4 (RIMSS) Special Support Equipment (SSE)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
description_text: The Surface Combatant/Gas Turbines Engineering Branch (Code 424) of the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD) is the In-Service Engineering Agent (ISEA) for the Ship Service Gas Turbine Generator (SSGTG). The Navy is establishing intermediate-level (I-level) procedures for the replacement of turbine assemblies at Regional Maintenance Center (RMC) turbine shops. This initiative will provide the Navy with a repair capability for 250-KS4s not previously possessed, significantly reducing repair turnaround times and enabling the refurbishment of previously unusable carcasses.
